builder.root_cause: THREE independent instances of one fault: a fact was written down twice, and nothing made the two copies agree. (1) --offline could never succeed because the Python versions were declared in both requirements.txt and upgrade-full.sh's PIN_* block, and the Vue version+hash in both prepare-offline.sh and upgrade-full.sh. prepare-offline.sh additionally prepended a comment line to the downloaded Vue file, so the bundled bytes could not match ANY content pin - not even the correct version's.
